entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: Leader of the Archon tyrants of Theros who ruled the empire of Trax for hundreds of years, riding a flying bull into battle.

entities.name: Trax
entities.description: Massive empire of centaurs, humans, leonin, minotaurs and satyrs ruled by the Archon tyrants.

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: King who led the rebellion that toppled Trax.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: King who led the rebellion that toppled Trax.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: First polis, born from the ashes of Trax.

events.summary: Trax fell to a rebellion led by kings Kynaios and Tiro, and Meletis was born from its ashes.
events.quote: Eventually, the empire of Trax fell to a rebellion led by kings Kynaios and Tiro
